name: Quaker Quick 1-Minute Oats (Cooked Creamy Oatmeal)
whyItWorks: Quick oats are rolled thinner and cut finer than old-fashioned oats. Boiling them in water breaks down the oat starch into a creamy colloidal suspension rich in soluble beta-glucan, which nourishes the gut microbiome and forms a protective coating.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer 1/2 cup quick oats in 1 cup water or lactose-free milk for 1–2 minutes until completely smooth and creamy. Top with pureed applesauce or sliced ripe bananas.
watchOuts: Must be thoroughly cooked until mushy; do not eat undercooked, dry, or raw rolled oats.
